QUOTE: `createPost` in `app/actions/remote/post.ts:74` saves the post locally first, with a `pending_post_id` and `props.failed` unset, so it shows up in the UI immediately. ... If the call throws, the post is kept and re-saved with `props.failed = true`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before the send, and on failure it is kept and re-saved with `props.failed = true`.
